text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It has arrived once again this year:
the summer training camp to hone our skills—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Summer! Hoy! Summer! Hoy! Summer! Hoy!
Come on, come on, come on, come on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The season where party animals shine the brightest!
The beach! Bikinis! BBQ! Fuuu!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Can you show us your party soul!?
We are the ones who possess scorching, legendary souls—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Swim, swim, swim!
Swim, swim, swim!
Swim, swim, swim!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's a chant of some sort!
I just tweaked one that was floating around on UmaTok.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, that really fired me up.
Our training camp is guaranteed to be a success now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally serious, Trainer!
Helios learned this specifically for the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I felt it too. Helios is seriously trying to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll get crazy strong at this camp,
and ride a massive wave with you, Milady!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if there's anything else I can do.
I'd be really happy if you relied on me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We weren't together last year, after all.
This year, I'm definitely going to be there for Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bestieee!!
Let's live our youth to the max☆
